project_summary: Electronic health records platform with FHIR-compliant API and HL7 integration for hospital networks

components.name: FHIR patient records API
components.description: RESTful API implementing FHIR R4 resources (Patient, Encounter, Observation) with versioning, terminology validation against SNOMED CT, and consent-based access control.

components.name: HL7 v2 hospital integration
components.description: Bidirectional HL7 v2.x messaging engine (ADT, ORM, ORU) with message transformation to FHIR, retry queues, and per-hospital routing configuration.

components.name: Appointment scheduling module
components.description: Slot-based scheduling with practitioner calendars, conflict detection, recurring availability rules, and patient self-booking portal.

components.name: GDPR audit logging
components.description: Immutable audit trail of all patient data access with retention policies, anonymized export for compliance reviews, and alerting on unusual access patterns.

project_summary: Plant monitoring system ingesting SCADA telemetry with real-time dashboards and alerting for steel production lines

components.name: SCADA telemetry ingestion
components.description: OPC UA client service ingesting sensor data from 12 production lines, with buffering for network outages, unit normalization, and dead-band filtering.

components.name: Real-time plant dashboard
components.description: Operator dashboard with live line status, temperature and pressure gauges, shift KPIs, and drill-down to individual sensor history.

components.name: Threshold alerting engine
components.description: Configurable alert rules per sensor with escalation chains (SMS, email, plant PA), acknowledgement workflow, and alert fatigue suppression.

components.name: Production shift reporting
components.description: Automated PDF shift reports with downtime summaries, OEE metrics, and export to the existing SAP plant maintenance module.

project_summary: Online grocery marketplace with delivery slot management and rider mobile app for last-mile logistics

components.name: Grocery storefront
components.description: Next.js storefront with category browsing, substitution preferences, weight-based pricing for fresh produce, and SSR for SEO.

components.name: Delivery slot management
components.description: Capacity-based delivery slot engine per postal zone with dynamic pricing for peak slots, cutoff rules, and slot reservation during checkout.

components.name: Rider mobile app
components.description: React Native app for delivery riders with route manifest, proof-of-delivery photo capture, offline mode for parking garages, and cold-chain checklist.

components.name: Payment and refund processing
components.description: Stripe integration with pre-authorization at checkout, final capture after weighing, and automated partial refunds for out-of-stock items.

project_summary: Open banking aggregation platform with PSD2 payment initiation and multi-bank account consolidation

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code with PKCE, client credentials) with JWT session management, token rotation, and per-client rate limiting.

components.name: PSD2 payment initiation service
components.description: PIS integration against 8 Spanish banks via Berlin Group NextGenPSD2 APIs, with SCA redirect handling, payment status polling, and idempotent retries.

components.name: Account aggregation engine
components.description: AIS consent lifecycle management, scheduled balance and transaction sync per bank, transaction deduplication, and category enrichment.

components.name: Notification service
components.description: Push and email notifications for payment status changes and consent expiry, with per-user channel preferences and delivery tracking.

components.name: Back-office admin panel
components.description: Internal console for support agents: consent lookup, payment trace viewer, bank connector health status, and manual retry triggers.

project_summary: Multi-vendor marketplace platform with Elasticsearch-powered search and a personalized recommendation engine

components.name: Product catalog service
components.description: Multi-vendor catalog with variant management, bulk CSV import per vendor, image processing pipeline, and category taxonomy administration.

components.name: Cart and multi-vendor checkout
components.description: Cart splitting per vendor, shipping cost calculation per parcel, order orchestration across vendors, and stock reservation with expiry.

components.name: Payment split and vendor payouts
components.description: Stripe Connect integration with payment splitting per vendor, commission calculation, scheduled payouts, and refund reconciliation.

components.name: Search and faceted navigation
components.description: Elasticsearch-backed product search with typo tolerance, Swedish language analyzers, faceted filters, and near-real-time index sync from the catalog.

components.name: Recommendation engine
components.description: Collaborative filtering recommendations (also-bought, similar items) with nightly model training, cold-start fallback rules, and A/B test hooks.

project_summary: Telemedicine platform with video consultations, e-prescriptions, and NHS Spine integration

components.name: Video consultation module
components.description: WebRTC video consultations via Twilio with waiting room, session recording consent flow, connection quality fallback to audio, and consultation notes.

components.name: E-prescription module
components.description: Electronic prescriptions with dm+d drug dictionary lookup, interaction warnings, controlled substance restrictions, and pharmacy dispatch integration.

components.name: Patient portal
components.description: Patient-facing portal for appointment booking, consultation history, document uploads, and prescription status tracking.

components.name: NHS Spine integration
components.description: Integration with NHS Spine services: PDS patient lookup and demographic sync, smartcard-based clinician authentication, and MESH message exchange.

project_summary: B2B ordering platform for automotive spare parts with EDI integration and warehouse management

components.name: B2B ordering portal
components.description: Dealer-facing portal with customer-specific price lists, VIN-based part compatibility search, bulk order upload, and credit limit enforcement.

components.name: EDI supplier integration
components.description: EDIFACT message exchange (ORDERS, DESADV, INVOIC) with 15 suppliers, mapping engine per supplier profile, and automated acknowledgement handling.

components.name: Warehouse management module
components.description: Bin-location inventory tracking, pick-list generation with route optimization inside the warehouse, barcode scanning flows, and cycle counting.

components.name: Sales analytics dashboard
components.description: Dealer and product-line sales analytics with monthly trend charts, dead-stock detection, and scheduled Excel exports for area managers.

project_summary: Digital wallet with KYC onboarding, card issuing, and real-time fraud detection for the Mexican market

components.name: Wallet core ledger
components.description: Double-entry ledger for wallet balances with idempotent transaction processing, SPEI transfer integration, and end-of-day reconciliation against the sponsor bank.

components.name: KYC onboarding flow
components.description: Tiered KYC with INE document capture and OCR, liveness detection via third-party SDK, CURP/RFC validation, and manual review queue for edge cases.

components.name: Card issuing integration
components.description: Virtual and physical card issuing via processor API, card lifecycle management (activate, freeze, replace), and webhook-driven transaction authorization.

components.name: Fraud detection rules engine
components.description: Real-time rules engine evaluating velocity checks, geolocation anomalies, and device fingerprints on each transaction, with case management for analysts.

components.name: Customer support console
components.description: Internal console for support agents with transaction search, dispute intake, KYC status override with dual approval, and audit trail.

project_summary: Fashion e-commerce replatform with ERP inventory synchronization and a customer loyalty program

components.name: Checkout and payments

components.name: Loyalty program
components.description: Points-based loyalty program with tier levels, birthday rewards, points redemption at checkout, and in-store redemption via QR codes.

components.name: Custody engine

components.name: Trading API

components.name: Compliance reporting

components.name: Client web dashboard
components.description: Institutional client dashboard with portfolio overview, withdrawal request initiation and approval tracking, API key management, and statement downloads.

project_summary: Insurance policy quotation engine with claims workflow automation and document OCR processing

components.name: Customer self-service portal

project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend

components.name: Sample tracking with barcodes

project_summary: IoT telemetry platform for wind farm monitoring with predictive maintenance based on machine learning

components.name: IoT telemetry ingestion

components.name: Time-series storage and downsampling
components.description: TimescaleDB storage with continuous aggregates for hourly/daily rollups, retention tiers (raw 90 days, aggregated 5 years), and query API for analytics.

components.name: Predictive maintenance models
components.description: Anomaly detection on vibration signatures and gearbox temperature trends, remaining-useful-life estimation per component, model retraining pipeline, and drift monitoring.

components.name: Operator dashboard

components.name: Route optimization engine

components.name: Driver mobile app

components.name: Automated billing
